question: Is the continuous gain multiplying the stable response state shared across the two answer-changing constructions A1 and A2?
evidence_status: CPU-only reporter-held-out gain-reuse screen; it does not identify the native source of gain or establish a causal intervention.

searched: crossconstruction task-tangent and restricted tensor records
prior_art_and_novelty.known_result: Cell-state error is 80.56% scalar amplitude, but each construction currently has its own fitted cell mean.
prior_art_and_novelty.novelty: Fit affine A1-to-A2 and A2-to-A1 gain maps on one reporter fold using directions learned only there, then predict opposite-fold gains and raw Q vectors. This tests reuse rather than adding state rank.

method.folds: The unchanged reversed modulo-4 reporter folds, balanced over direction.
method.gain: Within each fold and direction, fit raw A1 and A2 means qbar; each row gain is <Q,qbar>/||qbar||^2.
method.maps: Fit A2_gain=b0+b1*A1_gain and the reverse on fit reporters, then predict held-out reporters.
method.vector_test: Multiply the destination construction's fit qbar by the predicted held-out gain and score the raw destination Q vector.
method.no_cheat: Destination held-out Q is used only as the response after both the direction and affine map are fixed.

predictions.pred_a_authority_folds_projection_map_fi: Hashes, 4x16x4608 shape, balanced folds, nonzero means, projections, least-squares maps, finiteness, and counts match.
predictions.pred_b_target_constructions_share_predic: Pooled held-out Pearson and R2 are >=0.75 and >=0.50 in both A1-to-A2 and A2-to-A1 directions.
predictions.pred_c_gain_mapping_sign_and_scale_are_f: All four fitted slopes are positive and, within each mapping direction, max(abs(slope))/min(abs(slope)) <=2.0.
predictions.pred_d_transferred_gain_predicts_raw_des: For each mapping direction, pooled held-out raw-Q relative residual is <=0.25 and every row prediction has positive dot with destination Q.
predictions.pred_e_scope_is_gain_reuse_screen_only: No model/GPU call, H/R/v21 outcome, intervention, or held-out gain fit occurs.

opposing_outcomes.shared_crossconstruction_gain: A-E pass. Treat A1/A2 as readers of one continuous gain variable and seek one native H/R source on v21.
opposing_outcomes.directionally_asymmetric_gain: A/C/E pass and exactly one mapping passes B/D. Preserve an asymmetric construction interface.
opposing_outcomes.construction_specific_gain: A/E pass and neither mapping passes. Do not pool gain across constructions.
